Name: PARTS_BREAK_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines the behavior of broken parts.

Fields.Name: Joint Name
Fields.Description: The name of the model joint affected.

Fields.Name: Part Weight
Fields.Description: Override for the ragdoll weight in physics. -1: no override. 0 would make the part an immovable rigid body, so values are treated as at least 1.

Fields.Name: Body SFX Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the body side where the break effect plays. -1: the origin.

Fields.Name: Part SFX Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the part side where the break effect plays. -1: the origin.

Fields.Name: Body SFX ID
Fields.Description: The particle effect played on the body when the part breaks. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Part SFX ID
Fields.Description: The particle effect played on the part when it breaks. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Base Speed At Break
Fields.Description: Base initial speed that pushes the part away from the body at the moment it detaches. In metres per second. This speed does not depend on weight.

Fields.Name: Part Break Animation Type
Fields.Description: How the detached part is animated. 0: frozen in its pose at the moment of breaking. 1: keeps playing its animation. 2: turns into a ragdoll at once.

Fields.Name: Part Explosion SFX Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Part dummy poly for explosion SFX playback. -1 uses the origin.

Fields.Name: Body Explosion SFX Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Body dummy poly for explosion SFX playback. -1 uses the origin.

Fields.Name: Part Explosion SFX ID
Fields.Description: The particle effect played on the part when it explodes. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Body Explosion SFX ID
Fields.Description: The particle effect played on the body when the part explodes. -1: none.
